@about: Advanced simulation add-on for PartCraft (0.8 SU.891). Words of the add-on only; the study's own messages (supports, loads, faces gone) come from PartCraft's language file.
name: Advanced simulation
panel.honest: Nonlinear and contact studies on this part's Simulation study. An analysis aid for an engineer, not a design approval: check the numbers against hand calculations or another program.
part.heading: This part
part.no_study: The part has no Simulation study yet. Pick a study type below to start one, then set the material, supports and loads in the Simulation workspace.
part.need_bcs: Supports and loads are picked on faces in the Simulation workspace. This tab keeps the ones the study has.
type.heading: Study type
type.note: Nonlinear: the material follows a straight line to its yield stress, then a flatter slope. Contact: the same material, plus pieces of the part that press on each other. Both keep the study's supports, loads and material.
nl.et_note: Leave the slope empty for 1 % of E ({E} MPa). 0 means perfectly plastic: past the limit load the steps stop converging and the result says so.
pairs.heading: Contact pairs
pairs.gap: Look for faces up to (mm) apart
pairs.one_piece: The part is one piece. Contact needs two or more separate pieces (for example two rectangles in one sketch, extruded).
pairs.none: No flat faces of different pieces face each other within {gap} mm.
pairs.empty: No pairs yet. Find touching faces, or add a pair in the Simulation workspace and pick its faces there.
pairs.note: Contact is frictionless or bonded; results of a penalty method carry the stated penetration; use CalculiX for friction and large sliding.
pair.name: Pair {n}: side A {a}, side B {b}
run.heading: Run
res.heading: Result
res.heading_ccx: Result read from a CalculiX file
res.ccx_disp: {n} nodes; no stresses in the file (displacement only)
res.failed: Stopped: the step to {at} % of the load did not converge; {done} % is solved
res.pen.over: {p} mm, {pct} % of the {h} mm element: over 1 %, raise the penalty factor
plot.label: Plot
plot.shown: Colour bands placed: {n}, beside the part, shape × {scale}. They are display bodies: no mass, not exported.
plot.none: This result has nothing to plot.
plot.too_big: The plot has {n} triangles, more than the 60,000 the viewport takes from an add-on. Use the Simulation workspace's plot.
plot.legend: Blue {lo} to red {hi} {unit}; the shape is drawn {scale} times its real displacement.
plot.note: For the full plot with probes, solve the same study in the Simulation workspace: it is the part's own study.
ccx.heading: CalculiX
ccx.never_run: The CalculiX decks are written to CalculiX's manual and have never been run in CalculiX. Expect to fix the first deck by hand, and send the .log of a deck that fails to CadCraft.
ccx.note: CalculiX is a separate program you install and run yourself; nothing here runs it. Read the .frd back on the same part without changing the study, or the mesh will not match.
ccx.written: CalculiX deck saved: {n} nodes, {e} elements (never run in CalculiX).
ccx.read: CalculiX results read: {n} nodes, largest displacement {d} mm.
ccx.deck_head:
Written by PartCraft's Advanced simulation add-on (CadCraft). Units: mm, N, MPa, tonne.
NOT CHECKED IN CALCULIX: decks from PartCraft have never been run in CalculiX. Check the deck before you trust its results.
why.no_study: The part has no Simulation study. Pick Nonlinear or Contact first.
why.not_nl: The study is not a nonlinear or contact study. Pick Nonlinear or Contact first.
why.tet_only: Nonlinear and contact studies need the tetrahedral mesh.
why.nothing: Nothing to solve yet: the part has not been built.
msg.kind: The study is now: {kind}. Its supports, loads and material are kept.
msg.kind_new: A new study: {kind}. Set the material, supports and loads in the Simulation workspace.
msg.steps: Load steps are a whole number from 1 to 100.
msg.factor: The penalty factor is from 1 to 10,000.
msg.found: Facing faces found: {n}. Check them, then add them.
msg.run_done: Solved: largest displacement {d} mm, largest von Mises {s} MPa.
msg.run_failed: The solve stopped at {at} % of the load. See the result and Problems.
p.newton: Advanced simulation: the step to {at} % of the load did not converge ({done} % solved). Use more load steps or a slope after yield above 0.
p.penetration: Advanced simulation: the pieces sink {pen} mm into each other, {pct} % of the {h} mm element. Raise the pair's penalty factor.
cmd.pairs: Make a contact study and add the touching faces
